items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And that became a regular thing that I would come over and read with Art, I mean for Art.

ctx.x: So I came over and read that book to him and we drank beer and he really appreciated that, you

know. And I was so happy to be able to do that. And that became a regular thing that I would come over and read with Art, I mean for Art. And read these books dear friends to him you know. And we were really you know. Musically and human beings up until he died. Because he always used to talk about that. I know when he met Marian he used to talk about it. "Did Jimmy ever used to tell you he used to read for me all the time?"
